header.title: NNTP servers and fallback
header.description: The first server in the chain is used first. Missing or damaged segments fall over to the next active server; passwords are stored encrypted in the local vault only.

form.name: Primary provider
form.connections_hint: Maximum connections of this NNTP provider across all requests; one file uses all of them unless the general settings cap it

chain.title: Server chain
chain.description: Servers are tried from top to bottom. Use the arrows to change the fallback order.
chain.move_up: Move up in the fallback order
chain.move_down: Move down in the fallback order

delete.title: Delete Usenet server
delete.description: The NNTP server “{name}” and its encrypted password will be deleted permanently.
